items.title: What Does Abbott Laboratories (ABT) Gain From This New App Controlled Pump Rollout?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) is supplying its Instinct sensor for MiniMed's newly shipped app-controlled insulin pump in the U.S. The system pairs what MiniMed describes as the world's smallest app-controlled insulin pump with Abbott's smallest wearable glucose sensor. The commercial rollout broadens Abbott's role in diabetes care devices through integration into a widely accessible pump platform.
